name: Miyohashi Koori
source:
Likes: Earl Grey tea
Dislikes: Sweet foods
Favorite cake: Chocolate cake

A girl who lives and works at Folkroll. She lives there since it is convenient for her to go to school from there. She is a very serious and resolute person and is the backbone of Folkroll. However, she is clumsy with her hands and has a fatal weakness for a baker in that she is not fond of sweets. She is in charge of the coffee and tea served in the break area, which has a reputation for being delicious. She accepts Kurou in his time of trouble, but thinks that he should go home to his family as soon as possible.

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/clear_0018/]DMM[/url]]
